nina_cs: Morning — Weekly health check for SentryBox (onboarding cohort). Short version: error-rate climb driven by 5xx and timeouts during heavy import jobs. Renewal touchpoint in 3 days; want quick mitigations before the call.

7d vs prior 7d:
- total error-rate: 1.7% -> 6.9%
- 5xx: 0.5% -> 4.6%
- timeouts (gateway): x2.8 (mostly GET /internal/prefix-lookup)
- 429s: 0.2% -> 1.1% (bursty embeddings calls)

Top failing endpoints (last 24h):
1) POST /v1/complete — ~58% of 5xx, p95 1.6s, several 503s during peak
2) POST /v1/streaming-chat — dropped connections lead to retries and amplified load
3) POST /v1/embeddings — ~60% of errors are 429s during parallel imports
4) GET /internal/prefix-lookup — long prefix scans timing out

Context: SentryBox started a parallel import + validation job two days ago. Theyre on dedicated pool sb-ded-4. Onboarding progress stalled if these persist, likely to affect renewal sentiment.

ops-bot: ALERT: sentrybox-11 (SentryBox) 5xx > 3% for 25m. Incident: https://ops.redwood/alerts/INC-2234567890

alex_eng: Looking through logs now. Quick snippet from 2026-03-20T21:03:12Z:
```
[2026-03-20T21:03:12Z] worker: inference-21 allocation error: cannot reserve 900MB
[2026-03-20T21:03:13Z] proxy: upstream 502 from 10.30.4.2 for /v1/complete (req_id=cb01)
[2026-03-20T21:03:13Z] gateway: context deadline exceeded after 12s for /internal/prefix-lookup (req_id=cb02)
[2026-03-20T21:03:14Z] quota: applied 429 on /v1/embeddings (burst throttle)
```

alex_eng: Hypothesis: combo of memory pressure on larger model instances + client-side parallel retries for streaming/embeddings causing FD exhaustion and cascading 5xx/timeouts.

raja_infra: Agreed. Fast mitigations I can apply now:
- route SentryBox /v1/complete & /v1/streaming-chat -> fallback small-quant model (rwd-small-q4) for 90m
- bump sb-ded-4 max-instances +25% for 1h
- set per-tenant burst smoothing for embeddings to 12 rps and add Retry-After on 429s
Commands:
```
rwctl routing set --customer sentrybox-11 --route /v1/complete --fallback rwd-small-q4 --duration 90m
rwctl pool update sb-ded-4 --max-instances +25% --duration 1h
rwctl quota set --customer sentrybox-11 --route /v1/embeddings --burst-cap 12
```

mike_se: I can roll a lightweight runtime guard: detect OOM-prone processes and return 503 quickly with a Retry-After header so clients back off instead of retrying. Will canary to one node (ETA 20m). Also recommend adding short-circuit cache headers on their prefix lookups.

nina_cs: Great. Ill message SentryBox with a brief status: applied temporary fallback model + capacity bump + asking them to pause parallel import for 1 hour. Ill include a sample cache header and a suggested client backoff snippet.

renewal-bot: NOTICE: SentryBox renewal scheduled in 3 days. Current renewal risk: medium -> updated to "watch - mitigated" while team monitors.

ops-bot: NOTE: INC-2234567890 mitigations applied: model fallback + pool bump + quota throttle. Monitoring metrics for 45m.

alex_eng: Canary looks stable after 12m, no OOMs on canary node. If stable, rolling to 30% of sb-ded-4 in 15m.

raja_infra: Routing fallback and pool bump applied. Initial telemetry: overall 5xx dropped from 4.6% -> 2.1% in 10m, 429s down to ~0.9%.

mike_se: Added 503-fallback canary. Will expand if no regressions.

nina_cs: Thanks team. Follow-ups for post-incident: 1) post-mortem with SentryBox on why import pattern caused large prefix scans, 2) propose long-term quota/instance class change if they keep this workload, 3) update onboarding plan to include recommended client-side backoff and caching. Ill document in renewal tracker.
